items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And Ike, Ike Quebec, and Sam, you know, Sam the man Taylor.

ctx.x: Well, when did you eventually leave Cab, then?

I left Cab -- my last engagement was at Birdland, around about February or March or something like that, that was the last. Because we had reorganized again and made the -- after having the four pieces we had raised it back up to a big band again, which we went down to Uruguay, Montevideo, and played all down in there, you know, for the carnival, you know. And so he had had the guys, Doc Cheatham come back, and different guys he had, and Shad and all of them. And Ike, Ike Quebec, and Sam, you know, Sam the man…
Did Ike Quebec and Sam the Man sort of do any battling, you know, like Basie's two tenors, or --
